title: Fade in and out on login and logout
line: Logging out now fades the wallpaper and panels to black instead of cutting straight from the desktop to the login screen.
explanation: KWin's SessionManager::setState(uint) mapped ksmserver's states off by one (1 became Quitting, 2 became Normal and 0 became Saving), while the D-Bus interface and ksmserver use 0 normal, 1 saving, 2 quitting. So during the last phase of a logout KWin believed the session was back to normal, and the Session Quit effect, which is meant to keep the desktop on screen until the end, never kicked in: the screen jumped from the full desktop to the display manager. Also, cancelling a Wayland logout from KWin's "did not close" notification never reset KWin's state. The KWin commit maps the states as documented and makes the Session Quit effect fade desktop and panel windows to black (400 ms) when the session starts quitting, and fade them back if it returns to normal. App windows are not dimmed, so "save changes?" prompts stay readable. The plasma-workspace commit makes ksmserver's resetLogout() set KWin's state back to Normal, so a cancelled logout brings the desktop back.

commits.message:
effects/sessionquit: fade the desktop to black when logging out

KWin read the session states from ksmserver off by one, so it was never
in the quitting state at the end of a logout. Map them as documented and
fade the wallpaper and panels to black while the session is quitting.

BUG: 447083

ksmserver: tell KWin when a Wayland logout is cancelled

When an app refused to close and the logout was cancelled, KWin was left
thinking the session was still quitting, so the desktop stayed faded to
black. Reset KWin's session state together with our own.

BUG: 447083

patches.diff:
From b8b49f27d9d629aeec9742bfb80c2bb3f1a02513 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:37:20 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ksmserver: tell KWin when a Wayland logout is cancelled

When an app refused to close and the logout was cancelled, KWin was left
thinking the session was still quitting, so the desktop stayed faded to
black. Reset KWin's session state together with our own.

BUG: 447083
---
 ksmserver/logout.cpp | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/ksmserver/logout.cpp b/ksmserver/logout.cpp
index c1daa435d7..c21b482401 100644
--- a/ksmserver/logout.cpp
+++ b/ksmserver/logout.cpp
@@ -431,4 +431,5 @@ void KSMServer::timeoutQuit()
 void KSMServer::resetLogout()
 {
     state = Idle;
+    m_kwinInterface->setState(KWinSessionState::Normal);
 }
--

media.caption: Master: logout with an app that refuses to close. The desktop stays fully visible during the logout; after 10 s KWin's notification appears and the logout is cancelled
With the fix: wallpaper and panel fade to black as soon as the logout starts, the app and the notification stay readable, and cancelling brings the desktop back
Master, 1 s into a logout: the desktop is unchanged until the session ends abruptly
With the fix, 1 s into a logout: the desktop has faded to black, only the still-open app is shown
